description: Source code for the mac_metrics_aggregator class, which manages MAC and scheduler metrics reporting for cellular network cells, including report handling, activation/deactivation, and report aggregation.

classes.name: mac_metrics_aggregator::cell_metric_handler
classes.description: Handles metrics reporting for individual MAC cells, including report generation, activation, deactivation, and report reporting logic.

methods.name: report_preinit
methods.description: Prepares a new full_cell_report with reserved space for metrics based on maximum UEs and TDD slots.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the metrics aggregator, creating a handler for it.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the metrics aggregator.

methods.name: handle_pending_reports
methods.description: Processes all pending reports from active cells and attempts to send a new aggregated report.

methods.name: pop_report
methods.description: Pops the next report from a cell's report queue and adds it to the aggregation ring.

methods.name: try_send_new_report
methods.description: Checks if a new aggregated report is ready and forwards it to the notifier.

methods.name: handle_cell_activation
methods.description: Handles activation of a cell, initializing report timing.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation
methods.description: Handles deactivation of a cell, stopping report aggregation.
